discovery: A real-prefix audit showed that when a longer source array is present, a signal just before a registered stage end could inspect a planned exit after the stage boundary. The retained 2022-only artifact naturally prevented this, but the runner must remain safe when conditional later-stage data are present.
causal_rule: Before inspecting any post-entry high, low or exit price, reject a signal whose registered maximum-hold exit timestamp is greater than or equal to the exclusive evaluation-stage end.
change: Require planned_exit_time < stage_end_time before simulating a path.
reason_not_tuning: This physically enforces the preregistered development/selection/validation seals and is independent of family, parameters and observed profitability.
current_2022_result_effect: None, because the reused artifact ends at 2022-12-31T23:59:00Z and already made every cross-boundary path unavailable. The rule is added for reproducibility and future conditional-stage safety.
